adapter.terms: The site footer links 'API' to https://www.workingnomads.com/api/exposed_jobs/ (rendered home page, 2026-09-25) and robots.txt allows all paths ('User-agent: * / Disallow:' empty). The Terms and conditions (https://www.workingnomads.com/terms-and-conditions) say nothing specific about the feed; no parameters or rate limits are published.

search.note: Single keyless JSON array linked as 'API' from the site footer, with no documented query, location, page or limit parameters: nothing is sent and the whole current feed (a few dozen to a few hundred rows) is returned - filter client-side. Fields per the feed: url, title, description (HTML), company_name, category_name, tags (comma-separated string), location, pub_date. The feed has no id field, so id is the posting url.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: No per-id endpoint is published; re-read the record from the search hit (url).
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint; the posting url leads to the employer's application page.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging endpoint; only the public job feed is published.
